Veteran singer S. Janaki passes away at 88, tributes pour in

Legendary playback singer S. Janaki has died at the age of 88. Tributes have been pouring in from across the country, with political leaders and the film and music fraternities remembering her versatile voice and timeless melodies. Janaki was known for her extensive work in South Indian languages, though she also sang in Hindi and Sinhala.
